summary: Tested Brand Equity / Brand Health Check module end-to-end. Backend pytest: 11/11 PASS (templates, study CRUD, owner authorization, public token gating 410/200, regenerate questions, public response submission, dashboard aggregation with composite scores, AI background queue/status, delete cleanup). Frontend: list page, dashboard page, public respondent welcome page render correctly with full Swiss/editorial design. Created seed study (TEST_UIBrand) + 12 anonymous responses → dashboard shows score ring 84/100 Healthy, 4 dimension cards (AW 80 / PQ 86 / BI 80 / LY 91), Top-of-Mind word cloud, aided recognition, familiarity, AI insights placeholder. No console/page errors.
action_items: (Low) Add data-testid attributes to wizard step 2 trait chips (e.g., data-testid="trait-chip-Modern") and wizard step 3 launch button to make E2E Playwright automation easier. Currently the trait chips have no testid/role match, so automated tests must rely on text content which is fragile with Thai+English labels.

(Optional) Increase request timeout / streaming for the AI analysis call — under load, ai-analyze followed quickly by ai-status can exceed 15s on the preview ingress; backend itself returns fast but Gemini calls in the background task occasionally cause adjacent requests to be slow. Consider running Gemini calls with asyncio.to_thread or shielded so they don't share the FastAPI event loop with subsequent requests.
critical_code_review_comments: brand_equity.py is 752 lines — borderline; the AI prompt parsers and stats engine could be split into stats.py + ai.py for maintainability but not blocking.
_ai_extract_themes / _ai_identity_image / _ai_master_insights duplicate the same JSON-fence-stripping logic — extract a small _parse_json_response helper.
BrandEquity routes correctly use {'_id': 0} projection everywhere — no MongoDB ObjectId leakage.
Owner-authorization checks present on every /studies/{id}/* and ai-* endpoint (correct).
Public endpoints correctly strip owner_id/owner_email when returning study to respondent.
Dashboard threshold (n>=10) hardcoded — fine for MVP, document or make configurable later.

All numeric inputs from public respondents are coerced via isdigit() which handles strings well; ranking type is declared in QUESTION_TYPES but no template currently uses it (intentional / future-proofing).
